source_evidence.text: The eight-week trial will now distinguish routine and urgent offers, keep routine offers open for the printed channel, allocate paid hours by requested-hours rotation, and trigger a separate staffing review when recurring gaps cross the prewritten threshold.
Decline histories remain private, while members can voluntarily request help with a barrier.
Guaranteed schedules, quiet windows, committee auditing, weekly distribution reports, the pause vote, and the final member decision all remain.
